summary: The supplied video confirms repetitive generated text, but the exact Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 serving failure could not be reproduced without the reported model and EAGLE weights, request payload, logs, and model revision. Current source already contains last-layer all-reduce safeguards related to known Qwen3.5-family repetition failures; focused parser and fusion tests pass, but this is not sufficient to claim the original issue fixed.

tests.what_was_measured: Qwen3 Coder one-shot parsing and independently chunked streaming parsing; 2 passed, 241 deselected.
Focused Qwen3.5-family FlashInfer fused-collective boundary behavior; 10 passed.
The final-layer deferred-all-reduce fallback is absent before 5f216fc3, present in both Qwen decoder paths after that commit, and retained twice in the current source.
One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X was visible with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, and HIP 7.2.26015; no issue-equivalent model execution was performed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The GPU was inventoried only. Missing Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 and EAGLE weights prevented an issue-equivalent execution; no smaller fixture is represented as model reproduction.

remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 checkpoint and its EAGLE draft weights were unavailable.
The issue supplies no request payload, tool schema, raw response stream, server logs, exact image digest, tensor-parallel size, GPU type, or model revision.
The single assigned gfx950 cannot establish behavior of an unspecified multi-GPU deployment.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture does not qualify Qwen3.6 architecture, FP8 KV cache, Mamba extra_buffer, EAGLE/MTP, or semantic generation and was not used as a substitute.
